title: Timken Professor of Business Administration Charles B. (Tex) Thornton Chair of the Advanced Management Program
bio: Professor Montgomery's current research centers on the human side of strategy, and in particular the unique and abiding role leaders play in the formulation and implementation of strategy. Her article "Putting Leadership Back into Strategy," published in Harvard Business Review , January 2008, presents an overview of this stream of work. A book is in process.
